home_page.description: A personalised home page for one user. While it is live it replaces the default layout for that user.
home_page.dialect_rule: A page is published for one dialect. The app asks for the home page of the dialect it is currently set to, and shows a personalised page only if one exists for that dialect.

rules: A row with fewer than 3 valid titles is dropped by the platform.
A title is valid only if it is in the page dialect and available at publish time.
The same content (content_slug) can appear only once per page.
Continue Watching is added by the platform itself; the agent does not publish it.

home_page.timing_note: Users usually reach the home page within a few seconds of opening the app. A page that arrives later is seen only on a later visit while it is live.

push.frequency: At most 1 push or WhatsApp message per user per IST calendar day, both channels combined.

copy.price_claims: Only prices that exist in config/pricing.json.

push.delivery_note: Delivery is confirmed only by a message_delivered event. Some device tokens are no longer valid; the platform does not tell you which in advance.

approved_templates.text: Naya episode aa gaya! {{title_name}} ka episode {{episode_number}} ab dekhiye.
Aapka trial jald khatam ho raha hai. {{plan_price}} mein dekhte rahiye.

rules: Only approved templates can be sent.
Variables are filled from the catalogue or pricing; free text is not accepted.

in_app_message.description: Shown at the next app open.

no_action.description: Doing nothing is always allowed and must be recorded with its reason.
